subject: APAC control-plane graceful restart advisory
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: ops@vantageai.com, rachel@vantageai.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: APAC control-plane graceful restart advisory

Hello VantageAI ops team,

We plan a short, staged maintenance window on our APAC control plane to apply a driver/patch combination that addresses a connection rebalancing issue observed under heavy KV cache churn. The work will be a coordinated, rolling restart of control-plane nodes (no data plane redeploy) and is designed to be transparent to most customers. Details below: 

- Window: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 02:00–04:00 UTC (local APAC overnight)
- Impact: brief (up to 45s) connection handoffs for new inference requests to affected control-plane nodes; already-active streaming responses are expected to continue. No model reloading planned.
- Risk mitigation: staged restarts with health checks, automatic fallback to neighbouring region if a node fails L7 probes, and a pre-check run against a small traffic-shift group.
- Action for VantageAI: please confirm a pre-check acceptance test by 22 Apr 00:30 UTC if you want us to include your account in the initial verification cohort.

We will publish real-time updates to our status page and provide a runbook for your SREs to follow if they need to validate connections. Attaching the runbook and a short pre-maintenance checklist.

(Attachment: apac-graceful-restart-runbook-v1.pdf - 86KB)
(Attachment: pre-maintenance-checklist.csv - 3KB)

If you have a hard constraint that disallows any restarts in that window, tell us and we'll explore an alternate slot or an exception workflow.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: APAC control-plane graceful restart advisory

Jasmine — quick internal notes before we finalize the customer-facing message: 

- Can we tighten the initial pre-check cutoff to 00:00 UTC? Ops teams in APAC prefer a slightly earlier validation slot.
- For accounts in our dedicated pools, confirm whether we should add an explicit opt-out for Dedicated customers (some require SLA exceptions).
- Priyom, Ben — can you validate the fallback policy in the runbook section 3.2? I flagged a wording ambiguity around probe timeouts.

Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 01:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: APAC control-plane graceful restart advisory

Thanks for the heads up, Jasmine. Vantage ops can accept the window but we do have two asks: 

1) Please run the pre-check against our staging traffic group (ID: vstg-12) and share the results (latency percentiles + connection success) before the main rollout.
2) If anything unexpected occurs, please escalate to our on-call SRE, Ops Pager: +65 9123 4567 (Rachel Kim).

Please include our account in the initial verification cohort — we will be available for a quick handshake at 00:45 UTC if you want a live check.

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 00:45:00 +0000
Subject: APAC control-plane graceful restart advisory — pre-check confirmation & runbook

Hi Rachel / Vantage ops,

Thanks for confirming. We added VantageAI to the verification cohort and ran the pre-check against vstg-12 at 00:30 UTC. Summary: connection success 99.98%, p95 latency unchanged within noise band. No probe failures observed during the pre-check. Full logs and timing are in the attached runbook appendix.

Plan for the main rollout at 02:00 UTC: we will restart control-plane nodes in two phases (phase A: 02:00–02:45 UTC, phase B: 02:45–03:15 UTC) with a 15-minute observation window between phases. If any node fails L7 readiness for >90s we will halt the rollout and trigger automatic traffic failover to a neighbouring APAC cluster.

If you want an on-call conversation during the phase A window, Ben will be the primary contact (ben.carter@redwood.ai, +1 415-555-0109).

(Attachment: apac-graceful-restart-runbook-v1.pdf - 86KB)
(Attachment: pre-maintenance-checklist.csv - 3KB)

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
